blocks.text: Ab tak hum ne zarre ki seedhi lakeer mein harkat, yani ek dimension mein harkat, parhi hai. Ab kisi oonchai se ufqi (horizontal) taur par phenki gayi gend lein: yeh aage bhi jati hai aur neeche bhi girti hai jab tak zameen jaisi kisi cheez se na takraye. Farz karein gend phenkne wale ke haath se nuqte A par (Fig. 2.8a) poori tarah ufqi velocity vx se nikalti hai. Newton ke pehle qanoon ke mutabiq ufqi simt mein koi acceleration nahi hoga jab tak koi ufqi force gend par na lage; hawa ki raghrat nazar andaz karein to parwaz ke doran sirf gravity ki force lagti hai, to ufqi velocity badalti nahi aur zameen se takrane tak vx rehti hai. Ufqi harkat saada hai: gend mustaqil ufqi velocity component se chalti hai, to ufqi faasla x = vx t ... (2.17). Amoodi (vertical) harkat bhi pecheeda nahi: gend gravity ke tahat neeche tez hoti hai, a = g, bilkul azadana girte jism ki tarah; chunke ibtidai amoodi velocity sifr hai, Eq. 2.14 se amoodi faasla y = (1/2) g t^2.

blocks.title: Projectiles
blocks.text: Zaroori nahi ke cheez ko ibtidai velocity ufqi de kar phenka jaye. Khilari ki thokar se gayi football, cricketer ki phenki gend aur launching pad se dagi missile, sab ufuq se kisi zawiye par phenki hui, projectiles kehlati hain. Projectile motion gravity ke mustaqil acceleration ke tahat do-dimensional harkat hai.

Projectile ki harkat ko ufqi aur amoodi components mein tor kar aasani se parha ja sakta hai, jo ek doosre se azaad hain. Farz karein projectile ufuq se zawiya theta par velocity vi se dagi jati hai (Fig. 2.8b). Ufqi aur amoodi simton mein us ke components vi cos theta aur vi sin theta hain. Ufqi acceleration ax = 0 hai, kyunke hawa ki rukawat nazar andaz hai aur is simt mein koi aur force nahi lagti, jabke amoodi acceleration ay = g hai. Is liye ufqi component mustaqil rehta hai, aur kisi bhi waqt t par vfx = vix = vi cos theta ... (2.18). Amoodi harkat ke liye ibtidai amoodi component vi sin theta oopar ki taraf hai; kisi bhi lamhe t par amoodi component projectile ki oopar ki harkat ko ay = -g wali free fall maan kar pehli equation of motion se milta hai: vfy = vi sin theta - gt ... (2.19). Kisi bhi lamhe velocity ki miqdar v = sqrt(vfx^2 + vfy^2) ... (2.20) hai, aur yeh resultant ufuq se jo zawiya phi banata hai woh tan phi = vfy / vfx ... (2.21) se milta hai.

blocks.alt: Oopar baen: A se ufqi phenki gend, C tak us ka mura rasta mustaqil ufqi velocity teeron aur barhte amoodi velocity teeron ke saath. Oopar darmiyan: O se zawiya theta par ibtidai velocity vi se dagi projectile, parabola, choti par oonchai h aur range R. Oopar daen: oonchai, time of flight aur range ke formulas 45-degree nateeje ke saath. Neeche: Example 2.5, hawa ki rukawat ka asar aur do gendon ki tasveer ka bayan.
blocks.caption: Projectile motion: mustaqil acceleration g ke tahat do-dimensional harkat (Figure 2.8 aur topic 2.6 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Ufqi phenki gend apni ufqi velocity rakhti hai, kyunke koi ufqi force nahi lagti, jabke girai gayi gend ki tarah amoodi girti hai, to us ka ufqi faasla waqt ke tanasub se aur girawat waqt ke muraba ke tanasub se barhti hai. Zawiye par dagi projectile ka ufqi component mustaqil hai, ibtidai speed zarb zawiye ka cosine, aur amoodi component ibtidai speed zarb sine se shuru ho kar har second g se ghatta hai. Yeh tab tak uthti hai jab tak amoodi component sifr na ho, aisi oonchai tak jo ibtidai speed ke muraba aur zawiye ke sine ke muraba ke tanasub mein hai, ibtidai amoodi component ke do gune taqseem g ke barabar time of flight ke baad dagne ki satah par wapas aati hai, aur ibtidai speed ke muraba zarb do gune zawiye ka sine taqseem g ke barabar range tay karti hai, jo paintalees degrees par sab se zyada hai. Hawa ki rukawat oonchai aur range dono ghatati hai aur utraai ko charhai se zyada khari banati hai.

blocks.text: Zyada se zyada oonchai nikalne ko equation of motion 2aS = vf^2 - vi^2 istemal karein. Jism ke oopar jate waqt a = -g, ibtidai amoodi velocity viy = vi sin theta, aur vfy = 0 kyunke jism sab se oonche nuqte par pohnch kar ruk jata hai; S = oonchai = h ke saath, -2gh = 0 - vi^2 sin^2 theta, ya h = vi^2 sin^2 theta / (2g) ... (2.22). Hawa ki rukawat mein oonchai kam ho jati hai, jo projectile ki oopar ki velocity ghatati hai aur is liye us ki oonchai bhi.

Jism ko dagne ki jagah se zameen se takrane ki jagah tak faasla tay karne mein jo waqt lagta hai woh time of flight hai. Yeh S = h = 0 le kar milta hai, kyunke jism oopar ja kar usi satah par wapas aata hai, koi amoodi faasla tay nahi karta. Agar jism velocity vi se zawiya theta par daga jaye to us ka amoodi component vi sin theta hai, aur equation of motion S = vi t + (1/2) g t^2 ban jati hai 0 = vi sin theta t - (1/2) g t^2, to t = 2 vi sin theta / g ... (2.23), zameen se dagi projectile ka time of flight.

Projectile ufqi simt mein jo zyada se zyada faasla tay karti hai woh us ki range hai. Range R nikalne ko dagne ki velocity ke ufqi component ko dagne ke nuqte se nikal kar zameen se takrane tak ke kul waqt se zarb dein: R = vix x t = vi cos theta x 2 vi sin theta / g = (vi^2 / g) 2 sin theta cos theta. Chunke 2 sin theta cos theta = sin 2theta, range dagne ki velocity aur zawiye par munhasir hai: R = (vi^2 / g) sin 2theta ... (2.24). Zyada se zyada range ke liye factor sin 2theta = 1, to 2theta = sin^-1 (1) = 90 degrees, ya theta = 45 degrees. 45 degrees se kam zawiye par oonchai aur range dono kam hain; jab zawiya 45 degrees se bara ho to oonchai zyada magar range phir kam (Do You Know).

Hawa ki rukawat projectile ki aage ki harkat sust karti hai, us ki velocity vi ghatati hai, aur vi mein kami range ghatati hai. Mazeed yeh ke hawa ki rukawat poori parwaz mein mustaqil nahi: jaise cheez sust hoti hai us par hawa ki rukawat bhi ghatti hai, to cheez zyada aahista rukti hai aur girte hue zyada aahista tez hoti hai. Nateeja aisa rasta hai jo bilkul parabolic nahi balke terha hai, charhai se zyada khari utraai ke saath; hawa ki raghrat mein tez raftar projectile ka rasta parabolic raste se chhota reh jata hai (For Your Information). Ek saath chhori do gendon ki tasveer, ek azadana girai hui aur doosri ufqi dagi hui, har lamhe dono gendein ek hi satah par dikhati hai: un ke amoodi displacements barabar hain (Interesting Information).

blocks.title: Example 2.5
blocks.text: Ek gend 30 m s^-1 ki speed se ufuq se 30 degrees oopar ki simt mein phenki jati hai. Us ki oonchai, time of flight aur ufqi range nikalein. Hal: vix = vi cos theta = 30 m s^-1 x cos 30 = 25.98 m s^-1; viy = vi sin theta = 30 m s^-1 x sin 30 = 15 m s^-1. Time of flight t = 2 vi sin theta / g = 2 x 15 m s^-1 / 9.8 m s^-2 = 3.1 s. Oonchai h = vi^2 sin^2 theta / (2g) = (30 m s^-1)^2 (0.5)^2 / 19.6 m s^-2 = 11.5 m. Range R = (vi^2 / g) sin 2theta = (vi^2 / g) sin 60 = (30 m s^-1)^2 x 0.866 / 9.8 m s^-2 = 89.53 m (jaisa chhapa; 900 x 0.866 / 9.8 ka hisab 79.5 m deta hai).

R = vi^2 sin 2theta / g; 45 degrees par zyada se zyada

blocks.prompt: Dikhayein ke projectile ki range zawiyon theta aur 90 - theta ke liye ek jaisi hai, aur zyada se zyada oonchai tak pohnchne ka waqt nikalein (short questions 2.7, 2.8, 2.10).
blocks.explanation: R = vi^2 sin 2theta / g, aur sin 2(90 - theta) = sin (180 - 2theta) = sin 2theta, to mukammal (complementary) zawiye ek jaisi range dete hain aur nisbat R/R' = 1. Choti par vfy = 0, to vfy = vi sin theta - gt se zyada se zyada oonchai ka waqt t = vi sin theta / g hai, time of flight ka aadha.

items: Ufqi phenk: x = vx t, y = (1/2) g t^2; dono harkatein azaad. Zawiya theta par projectile: vfx = vi cos theta, vfy = vi sin theta - gt, v = sqrt(vfx^2 + vfy^2), tan phi = vfy/vfx.
h = vi^2 sin^2 theta / 2g; t = 2 vi sin theta / g; R = vi^2 sin 2theta / g, 45 degrees par zyada se zyada; hawa ki rukawat oonchai aur range ghatati aur rasta terha karti hai (khari utraai).
